name: Al Bateen Executive Airport

runway.v: one runway, 13/31, 3.2 km long (width not stated by the operator)

hours.quote: A high-precision technical ecosystem operating 24/7 with zero slot restrictions and a 50-stand apron layout

slots.v: no slot restrictions, as stated by the operator
slots.quote: With no slot restrictions, no holding patterns, and short taxi times, AZI accommodates the demands

max_aircraft.v: aircraft up to code D (Boeing 767 size); up to 50 aircraft stands
max_aircraft.quote: Aircraft Category | Up to Code D, B767 equivalent ... Apron capacity | Up to 50 aircraft stands

handling.v: Jetex runs the FBO, opened in 2023
handling.quote: The Jetex FBO, opened in 2023, adds another layer of luxury.

notes: All facts are from the operator's own websites (albateenairport.ae, adairports.ae); the UAE AIP AD 2 OMAD text could not be found or opened, so no AIP coordinates. Runway length is the operator's rounded '3.2km' (longest_m 3200 is therefore approximate). '24/7' is an operating-hours statement, not an explicit 'no night restriction', so curfew is left missing. The site lists 'Customs and immigration facilitation' only as a handling service, with no hours. Stand counts differ between sites (50 on albateenairport.ae, 54 on adairports.ae): only the 50 figure from the airport's own spec table is used. The site footer shows a ground-handling logo named 'Munawala' but gives no name in text, so it is not recorded. | 2026-10-31 run: nothing new verified; albateenairport.ae 'At the Airport' page returns 404, current UAE AIP AD 2 OMAD not reachable.
